notes.title: Shrine of Lovebirds Update
notes.content:
The Shrine of Lovebirds interior went through a slight graphical upgrade.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44643782/054e51ae5f48614901c78d87bb1aa2720976b859.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Additional Fixes
notes.content:
The following was fixed:
[list]
[*] Arwen's portrait bust will now correctly be removed while travelling through the Lovebirds Valley.
[*] After teleporting from Shrine of Lovebirds, the menu background will correctly change to Fallhorn city.
[/list]

notes.title: Small fixes
notes.content:
The following was fixed:
[list]
[*] Required Level to learn a talent will now be more visible in the talent menu when a character does not meet the required level.
[*] After teleporting back to Fallhorn from the Shrine, the Active Quest Window will no longer be missing.
[*] Some grammar.
[/list]

notes.title: Quick Fix
notes.content:
Things that were fixed:
[list]
[*] When using the [b]OPTIMIZE[/b] option in the Equip screen, items for which the level requirement is not met will no longer be equipped.
[/list]

notes.title: Small Graphic Update
notes.content:
The following was updated:
[list]
[*] Elizar's battler graphic will now look more in style with the rest of the game.
[/list]

notes.title: Small Changes and Fixes
notes.content:
The following was changed:
[list]
[*] In-game playtime will now be more accurate.
[*] Some grammar mistakes were corrected.
[*] Title menu graphics have been slightly changed.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44643782/a3e152027e86bc8b947f18aaa49a79fabaed4b61.png[/img]

notes.title: Small fixes
notes.content:
[b]The following was fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] Players will no longer be able to skip Ryder's first few turns when rescuing Arwen.
[*] The flickering in the catacombs has been slightly improved.
[/list]

notes.title: Small Fixes
notes.content:
[b]The following was fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] After rescuing Arwen, when going back to the beach, the slimes will no longer roam weirdly.
[*] The final scene of the game will no longer get stuck sometimes in an endless loop.
[/list]

notes.content:
[h2]❤️ 15 Awesome steam achievements are now available for you to unlock! !!! ❤️[/h2]

[/list]

notes.title: Additional Quick Fix
notes.content:
[list]
[*]When asking Arwen to the graduation ball at the ladies dorms, Ryder's name will correctly display now.
[/list]

notes.title: Quick Fix
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixing Catacombs where after draining the water from the sub-basement, when exiting sub-basement the water in the basement would return.
[/list]

notes.title: Fixing Heart Meter
notes.content:
[h2]❤️ Wishing you all a [b]HAPPY HOLIDAY SEASON[/b]!!! ❤️[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44643782/d4a184dd96828555ae51e972b6d371fca4013756.gif[/img]

[h3]The following was fixed:[/h3][list]
[*]When cycling through characters in the status screen, the heart meter will no longer display for Ryder and Ellie.
[/list]

notes.title: Forge Patch
notes.content:
[list]
[*] While using the forge, the number of remaining gems will now update correctly when a weapon upgrade is purchased.
[/list]
[h1]Wishing everyone a happy holiday season![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44643782/905995cae0cb6caabda291ac37b21aa535673fd4.png[/img]

notes.title: Small Fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*]After Arwen joins the party, the hidden potion event will now correctly happen the first time Arwen's HP drops too low in battle.
[*]When Arwen re-joins the party and prior to seeing the Mayor with her, Arwen will no longer tell Ryder to head south upon entering Fallhorn forest.
[/list]

notes.title: Small Fixes
notes.content:
More small fixes:
[list]
[*] Thundering Tornado book event now contains correct face graphics.
[*] Leaving the academy catacombs now will play the correct music.
[/list]

notes.title: More Fixes!
notes.content:
Small fixes:
[list]
[*] Some grammar mistakes.
[*] In the Shrine, under certain conditions, a second Arwen sprite would show up.
[/list]
Happy November and a Holiday Season to everyone!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44643782/c6a93a4e5071c449f6691f37517d4c494425d4ae.png[/img]
